kind: authored synthetic example; no live agent execution

repositories.name: repo-alpha
repositories.contract: Coordinator owns Git and the test runner. Writer owns app/banner.py only. A fresh reviewer reads the frozen change; an independent verifier checks claims before fixes. Keep notes and task state local.

task.goal: Dismiss a visible notice without starting a refresh.
task.acceptance: Dismiss clears the notice and starts zero refreshes.
task.optional_lifecycle: Warmboot-style task record shown only as an example; no installation required.

repositories.tests:
from app.banner import dismiss

state = {"notice": "Try again", "refreshes": 0}
result = dismiss(state)
assert result["notice"] is None
assert result["refreshes"] == 0
assert state["notice"] == "Try again"
print("repo-alpha: PASS")

repositories.name: repo-beta
repositories.contract: Coordinator owns Git. A named test owner runs checks. This repository uses a short local checklist, without a lifecycle tool. A worker edits only the assigned path; review claims need independent verification.

task.goal: Explain whether a lane finished the assigned review.
task.acceptance: An exit-zero process with no final verdict remains incomplete.

repositories.note: The first review process exited zero but supplied no accepted final verdict. It remains incomplete. Its partial output is preserved privately. A fresh replacement reviewer supplied the scoped finding, then an independent verifier checked it.

sessions.evidence: Synthetic baseline dismiss started a refresh; corrected dismiss clears only the notice.

repo-alpha.unproved: Real user interface and live agent behavior

repo-beta.next: Use the preserved lane receipt to explain incomplete versus accepted review

shared_rules: Shared sample practice: one coordinator owns each repository Git lease; workers edit assigned paths only; name the test owner; process success is not review acceptance; an independent verifier checks each claim; handover names proof and limits.
